question: What is the name of the desert that is located in North-west India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Thar Desert__ is located in India (Rajasthan) and is also known as the Great Indian Desert.
 
• The Thar Desert extends between the Aravalli Hills in the northeast and the Rann of Kutch in the west and the alluvial plains of the Indus River in the northwest.
 
• It is located partly in the Rajasthan state of India and partly in the Punjab and Sindh provinces of Pakistan.
 
• The Aravalli Range is the oldest range of fold mountains in India.
 
• The Great Rann of Kutch is a salt marsh in the Thar Desert in the Kutch District of Gujarat.
 
• It is one of the largest salt deserts in the world.
 
• The Black Buck is a species of antelope found mainly in the Thar region.
